item.title: State Board sends letters to voters with unvalidated identification numbers
item.description: RALEIGH - The State Board of Elections is sending letters to more than 241,000 North Carolina voters who provided identification numbers when they registered to vote that did not validate against other government databases. The letters encourage these voters to update their voter records by providing their driver’s license or social security numbers or by ensuring the name on their voter registration matches other official government records. item.title: Northampton County awarded $500,000 State Economic and Infrastructure Development Grant
item.description: GARYSBURG – Northampton County was recently awarded a $500,000 State Economic and Infrastructure Development (SEID) grant by the Southeast Crescent Regional Commission (SCRC). These funds will be used for a lift station replacement in the Town of Garysburg. This project was chosen by the SCRC due to strong alignment with the priorities identified in SCRC’s authorizing statute, Five-Year Strategic Plan, and State Economic Development Plan. item.title: Henry C. Matthews, Jr.
item.description: TARBORO – Henry Clinton Matthews, Jr., 89, formerly of Ahoskie, NC, passed away peacefully on Saturday, January 31, 2026, at Edgecombe Health Center. Born on January 7, 1937, in Bertie County, NC, he was the beloved son of the late Henry Clinton Matthews, Sr., and Daisy Broglin Matthews. item.title: David A. Fortney
item.description: CONWAY – David "Dave" Alvin Fortney, age 66, of Conway, North Carolina, passed away on February 2, 2026, at ECU Health Roanoke-Chowan Hospital. Born on July 5, 1959, in Canton, Ohio, Dave was the beloved son of the late William David Fortney and Mary Iva McKinney Fortney. Throughout his life, Dave worked diligently as a millwright, dedicating his skills and passion to his trade.
